load_reference_model: load a reference model from a named asset card or custom checkpoint path using _ReferenceModelLoader
bootstrap_standard_model: bootstrap a standard reference model by name from the asset store using _StandardReferenceModelBootstrapper
bootstrap_custom_model: bootstrap a custom reference model from a file path and model family using _StandardReferenceModelBootstrapper
prepare_model_for_inference: prepare a model holder by broadcasting across processes and optionally compiling using _LastReferenceModelPreparer
delegate_model_preparation: delegate model preparation to multiple preparers in sequence using _DelegatingReferenceModelPreparer
